correctness.rationale: In cyclic quotient order r, ∫|a+bχ+cχ²|^6 is Σ residue classes modulo r of squared coefficients of (a+bz+cz²)^3. The reflected three-coefficient RMS symmetrization increases each nonnegative cyclic autocorrelation via Cauchy, forcing |a|=|c| at the strict positive optimum. Exact residue polynomial E_r(t), derivative sign polynomial and positive-root uniqueness distinguish r3,4,5,6 and r≥7; for r≤6 phase alignment across degree-0/degree-r collisions forces ω^r=1, while r≥7 has no phase wrapping. Decompose G into h cosets of K=H⊥: ℓ³ concentration forces one coset and multiplier h². Independent exact cyclic-moment calculations for r3..11 and source symbolic verifier corroborate; the full proof treats all finite abelian groups.
